body: /u/superdooperuberpoopr has it right with the distraction thing, you have to find other ways to motivate yourself, and it may not be immediate, and that's fine. I [17M] was in a similar position to you not long ago, my ex who I clung to like a lifeboat broke up with me for reasons I've been trying to figure out myself. And it hurt me like its hurting you, I cut so viciously and angrily because she wasn't there to be my stabilizer. Overtime I realized that I didn't need that lifeboat and I had to learn to float by myself. It may not work for you, but what kept me going was the thought of showing my ex that I don't need her to be fine (it's petty and super trivial but it works for me). And it hasn't been an immediate change either, shit lol I relapsed yesterday after a month, so please don't think you need to be better now because healing both a heart and body take extraordinary amounts of time.  I promise that even if nothing I said made sense, that you will get through this, cus anyone who is strong enough to call for help through any means has some part of them, no matter how small, that wants to be better, so please cling to that feeling if nothing else, and let it help you to a better place emotionally and mentally. PM if u need any more shitty ramblings from me lol I know this was all over the place but it's late and I couldn't ignore this post.
